meanings.en: other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)

meanings.note: Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.

examples.text: Да это не воровство, послушай! Это абсолютно безопасно.
examples.trans: That's not stealing, listen! It's completely safe.

examples.text: Я приехала к очень серьёзному человеку.
examples.trans: I have come to see a very important man.

examples.text: Я приехала к очень серьёзному человеку. Он меня ждёт.
examples.trans: I have come to see a very important man. He is waiting for me.

meanings.note: pointing at a thing or a situation; 'это' + noun = 'this is ...'
points at something: это моё = that's mine

meanings.en: other forms: этого, этому, это, этим, этом

examples.trans: And this is for you. A toy car!

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates

examples.trans: Arkasha, I didn't expect that. Thank you!

meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'ледовать'). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'ought to, should have'.

examples.trans: I researched the history of our town.

meanings.note: Core Russian adv meaning 'yesterday' in everyday speech.

examples.text: Я вчера ел маринованные грибы. Может, один гриб был плохой.
examples.trans: Yesterday I ate pickled mushrooms. Maybe one mushroom was bad.

meanings.note: the present tense is normally left out: я мэр = I am the mayor
present есть; у меня есть = I have

examples.trans: You will be asking for forgiveness.

meanings.note: ничего не осталось = there's nothing left

examples.text: Ну что, очкарик? Видишь, ничего не осталось.
examples.trans: Well, four-eyes? See, there's nothing left.
I grew up in a communal flat.
Hello! How was it in Hungary?

examples.text: В прошлый раз я думала, война началась.
examples.trans: Last time I thought a war had started.

examples.text: Марина, ну опять ты со своей сгущёнкой! В прошлый раз я думала, война началась.
examples.trans: Marina, there you go again with your condensed milk! Last time I thought a war had started.

examples.text: Привет! Смотри, что у меня есть.

examples.trans: If you don't want to, suit yourself.
They want to build a shopping centre there.

examples.text: Меня уже тошнит от этой коммуналки! У нас труба уже неделю течёт.
examples.trans: I'm sick of this communal flat! Our pipe has been leaking for a week now.

examples.text: А я испорчу отношения с будущим мэром.
examples.trans: And I'll ruin my relationship with the future mayor.
We have a very warm relationship.

examples.text: Ты с ума сошёл? У нас с тобой только деловые отношения!
examples.trans: Have you lost your mind? Between you and me it's strictly business!
I love our town very much.

examples.text: Я очень люблю наш город. Поэтому я иду на второй срок.
examples.trans: I love our town very much. That's why I'm running for a second term.

стараться.gloss: to try, to make an effort

meanings.en: to try hard, to make an effort
meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'тараться'). Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to try, to make an effort', paired with 'постараться'.

examples.trans: He always tries to help his friends.

examples.text: Марина, зря вы стараетесь. Он никогда не уйдёт от своей Аллы Евгеньевны.
examples.trans: Marina, you're trying in vain. He will never leave his Alla Evgenyevna.

meanings.note: Negative prefix 'не-' ('un-, non-, not') (stem 'достаточно'). Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.

examples.text: Это слово «недостаточно» часто звучит в разговоре.
examples.trans: This word 'not enough' is often heard in conversation.
We need to do even more.

examples.text: Мы сделали много, но надо сделать ещё больше.
examples.trans: We've done a lot, but we need to do even more.
The film has a happy ending.

examples.text: Ты сейчас один против всех. Счастливого конца не будет.
examples.trans: Right now you're alone against everyone. There won't be a happy ending.

meanings.note: + instrumental; со before some consonant clusters: со всеми

examples.trans: Share it all equally with everyone, understand?
